record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Speak<WH0559><WTH8798> unto the priests<WH03548> the sons<WH01121> of Aaron<WH0175>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, There shall none be defiled<WH02930><WTH8691> for the dead<WH05315> among his people<WH05971>:

But for his kin<WH07607>, that is near<WH07138> unto him, <FI>that is<Fi> , for his mother<WH0517>, and for his father<WH01>, and for his son<WH01121>, and for his daughter<WH01323>, and for his brother<WH0251>,
And for his sister<WH0269> a virgin<WH01330>, that is nigh<WH07138> unto him, which hath had no husband<WH0376>; for her may he be defiled<WH02930><WTH8691>.

<FI> But<Fi> he shall not defile<WH02930><WTH8691> himself, <FI>being<Fi> a chief man<WH01167> among his people<WH05971>, to profane<WH02490><WTH8736> himself. <RF>he...: or, being an husband among his people, he shall not defile himself for his wife, etc<Rf>

They shall not make<WH07139><WTH8799> baldness<WH07144> upon their head<WH07218>, neither shall they shave off<WH01548><WTH8762> the corner<WH06285> of their beard<WH02206>, nor make<WH08295><WTH8799> any cuttings<WH08296> in their flesh<WH01320>.

They shall be holy<WH06944> unto their God<WH0430>, and not profane<WH02490><WTH8762> the name<WH08034> of their God<WH0430>: for the offerings<WH0801><WH00> of the LORD<WH03068> made by fire<WH0801>, <FI>and<Fi> the bread<WH03899> of their God<WH0430>, they do offer<WH07126><WTH8688>: therefore they shall be holy<WH06918>.

They shall not take<WH03947><WTH8799> a wife<WH0802> <FI>that is<Fi> a whore<WH02181><WTH8802>, or profane<WH02491>; neither shall they take<WH03947><WTH8799> a woman<WH0802> put away<WH01644><WTH8803> from her husband<WH0376>: for he <FI>is<Fi> holy<WH06918> unto his God<WH0430>.

Thou shalt sanctify<WH06942><WTH8765> him therefore; for he offereth<WH07126><WTH8688> the bread<WH03899> of thy God<WH0430>: he shall be holy<WH06918> unto thee: for I the LORD<WH03068>, which sanctify<WH06942><WTH8764> you, <FI>am<Fi> holy<WH06918>.

And the daughter<WH01323> of any<WH0376> priest<WH03548>, if she profane<WH02490><WTH8735> herself by playing the whore<WH02181><WTH8800>, she profaneth<WH02490><WTH8764> her father<WH01>: she shall be burnt<WH08313><WTH8735> with fire<WH0784>.<CM>

And <FI>he that is<Fi> the high<WH01419> priest<WH03548> among his brethren<WH0251>, upon whose head<WH07218> the anointing<WH04888> oil<WH08081> was poured<WH03332><WTH8714>, and that is consecrated<WH04390><WTH8765><WH03027> to put<WH03847><WTH8800> on the garments<WH0899>, shall not uncover<WH06544><WTH8799> his head<WH07218>, nor rend<WH06533><WTH8799> his clothes<WH0899>;
Neither shall he go in<WH0935><WTH8799> to any dead<WH04191><WTH8801> body<WH05315>, nor defile<WH02930><WTH8691> himself for his father<WH01>, or for his mother<WH0517>;

Neither shall he go out<WH03318><WTH8799> of the sanctuary<WH04720>, nor profane<WH02490><WTH8762> the sanctuary<WH04720> of his God<WH0430>; for the crown<WH05145> of the anointing<WH04888> oil<WH08081> of his God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> upon him: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.
And he shall take<WH03947><WTH8799> a wife<WH0802> in her virginity<WH01331>.

A widow<WH0490>, or a divorced woman<WH01644><WTH8803>, or profane<WH02491>, <FI>or<Fi> an harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>, these shall he not take<WH03947><WTH8799>: but he shall take<WH03947><WTH8799> a virgin<WH01330> of his own people<WH05971> to wife<WH0802>.
Neither shall he profane<WH02490><WTH8762> his seed<WH02233> among his people<WH05971>: for I the LORD<WH03068> do sanctify<WH06942><WTH8764> him.<CM>
And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> unto Aaron<WH0175>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Whosoever<WH0376> <FI>he be<Fi> of thy seed<WH02233> in their generations<WH01755> that hath <FI>any<Fi> blemish<WH03971>, let him not approach<WH07126><WTH8799> to offer<WH07126><WTH8687> the bread<WH03899> of his God<WH0430>. <RF>bread: or, food<Rf>

For whatsoever man<WH0376> <FI>he be<Fi> that hath a blemish<WH03971>, he shall not approach<WH07126><WTH8799>: a blind<WH05787> man<WH0376>, or a lame<WH06455>, or he that hath a flat nose<WH02763><WTH8803>, or any thing superfluous<WH08311><WTH8803>,
Or a man<WH0376> that is brokenfooted<WH07667><WH07272>, or brokenhanded<WH07667><WH03027>,

Or crookbackt<WH01384>, or a dwarf<WH01851>, or that hath a blemish<WH08400> in his eye<WH05869>, or be scurvy<WH01618>, or scabbed<WH03217>, or hath his stones<WH0810> broken<WH04790>; <RF>a dwarf: or, too slender<Rf>

No man<WH0376> that hath a blemish<WH03971> of the seed<WH02233> of Aaron<WH0175> the priest<WH03548> shall come nigh<WH05066><WTH8799> to offer<WH07126><WTH8687> the offerings<WH0801><WH00> of the LORD<WH03068> made by fire<WH0801>: he hath a blemish<WH03971>; he shall not come nigh<WH05066><WTH8799> to offer<WH07126><WTH8687> the bread<WH03899> of his God<WH0430>.
He shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the bread<WH03899> of his God<WH0430>, <FI>both<Fi> of the most<WH06944> holy<WH06944>, and of the holy<WH06944>.

Only he shall not go in<WH0935><WTH8799> unto the vail<WH06532>, nor come nigh<WH05066><WTH8799> unto the altar<WH04196>, because he hath a blemish<WH03971>; that he profane<WH02490><WTH8762> not my sanctuaries<WH04720>: for I the LORD<WH03068> do sanctify<WH06942><WTH8764> them.
And Moses<WH04872> told<WH01696><WTH8762> <FI>it<Fi> unto Aaron<WH0175>, and to his sons<WH01121>, and unto all the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>.<CM>
